description: Each monoamine receptor's coupling and the layer's sign for it: Galpha-i/o-coupled and ligand-gated Cl- channels inhibitory, Galpha-q- or Galpha-s-coupled excitatory. This is the layer's rule for the receptor's effect on the cell that carries it, not a claim that cAMP or Gq signalling has one sign in every cell. A receptor whose coupling is not established by a cited assay has sign null and is fitted. Quotes are from the cited full texts or, where those are not open access, their abstracts; verified 2026-10-24.

ser-1.quote: three G-protein-coupled receptors, SER-1, SER-4, and SER-7, which appear to couple to Gαq, Gαo, and Gαs, respectively
ser-1.note: Hamdan et al. 1999 (PMID 10098838): Ca2+-mediated signalling in heterologous cells

ser-4.quote: SER-4 ... Gαo; 5HT-Ce ... mediates adenylate cyclase attenuation

ser-5.quote: supporting the identification of SER-5 as a Gαs-coupled 5-HT receptor (from clustering with receptors of documented coupling)
ser-5.note: No functional coupling assay found; fitted.

ser-7.quote: couples to a stimulation of adenyl cyclase when expressed in COS-7 cells

mod-1.quote: encodes a new type of ionotropic 5-HT receptor, a 5-HT-gated chloride channel
mod-1.note: Inhibitory where E_Cl lies below the resting potential, the layer's assumption for every Cl- channel.

dop-1.quote: D1- and D2-like receptors that activate the antagonistic Galpha(q) and Galpha(o) signaling pathways, respectively
dop-1.note: No heterologous coupling assay found; Bentley 2016 also calls it excitatory.

dop-2.citation: Suo et al. 2003 (PMID 12887685); Suo et al. 2009 (PMC2735167)
dop-2.quote: DOP-2 and DOP-3 are D2-like receptors that couple to Gi/o

dop-3.citation: Chase, Pepper & Koelle 2004 (PMID 15378064); Sugiura et al. 2005 (PMID 16001968)

dop-4.quote: DOP-4 stimulates cAMP accumulation in response to dopamine stimulation

lgc-53.quote: LGC-53 is a high-affinity dopamine receptor ... LGC-40, LGC-53 and LGC-55 are chloride channels
lgc-53.note: Inhibitory where E_Cl lies below the resting potential.

ser-3.citation: Mills et al. 2012, EMBO J 31:667 (PMC3273394); Suo et al. 2006 (PMC6674634)
ser-3.quote: OCTR-1 and SER-3 are Gαo and Gαq coupled, respectively

ser-6.coupling: Galpha-s (in vivo); a Gq-like readout in oocytes
ser-6.citation: Mills et al. 2012 (PMC3273394); Fernandez et al. 2020 (PMC7511189)
ser-6.quote: OA/SER-6 stimulates the Gαs-dependent release of multiple peptides; SER-6 is coupled to the excitatory G protein Gαs
ser-6.note: The coupling conflicts between assays, but both readings are excitatory, so the sign is fixed.

octr-1.quote: OCTR-1 and SER-3 are Gαo and Gαq coupled, respectively

ser-2.quote: tyramine reduces forskolin-stimulated cAMP levels in HEK293 cells stably expressing SER-2; SER-2 is coupled to the inhibitory G protein Gαo
ser-2.note: Rex et al. 2004 (PMID 15569254) also report a small Ca2+ rise; every review calls it Gαo.

tyra-2.quote: TYRA-2 encodes a second Galpha(i/o)-coupled tyramine receptor

tyra-3.quote: These data suggest that TA-dependent activation of TYRA-3 increased Gαq signaling

lgc-55.citation: Ringstad, Abe & Horvitz 2009 (PMC2963310); Pirri et al. 2009, Neuron 62:526 (PMC2804440)
lgc-55.quote: LGC-55 is a high-affinity tyramine receptor ... chloride channels
lgc-55.note: Inhibitory where E_Cl lies below the resting potential.
